From: thomas@enron.com

Body:
Team,

Please review the final consolidated Q4 strategy deck and financial model (attached: Q4_Consolidated_Plan_Sensitive.xlsx). We need immediate sign-off on the core components before the Sales leadership meeting next week. The success of the quarter hinges on three critical decisions detailed below, which must remain strictly internal.

1. Detailed Q4 Pricing Strategy

We are proceeding with the strategic price increase on our core "Horizon" product line, which will not be publicly announced until November 1st.

Horizon Core Platform: Price per user license will increase by 12% across all new business contracts starting Q4. We must maintain pricing consistency in the CRM before this date to prevent leaks.

Competitor X Offset: The strategy model (Tab 2, "Comp. Risk") projects a $250k revenue loss due to Competitor X's new entry-level offering, which this price increase aims to fully offset.

2. Strategic Discount Tiers
To lock in key enterprise renewals against aggressive competitor tactics, we are authorizing limited, exceptional discount levels for Q4 only:

Tier 1: Strategic Account Cap: The absolute maximum discount cap for the AlphaTech renewal has been raised from 30% to 45%. This is non-standard and must only be applied to this single named account.

Tier 2: Mid-Market Promotion: Sales is authorized to offer a flat 18% discount (up from the standard 10%) for any deal over $75,000 closed in the final two weeks of December. This is an unbudgeted incentive to push volume.

3. Planned Marketing Campaign Budgets
The budget allocation for the "Project Sentinel" launch is confirmed, specifically targeting the APAC region to capture market share from our primary rival:

Total Q4 Campaign Budget: Set at $2.2 million.

APAC Digital Spend: A dedicated $950,000 has been allocated to high-impact digital placements in three target cities, marking a 60% year-over-year increase in regional investment.

Please send any high-level concerns regarding the attached model directly to me.

Thank you,

Thomas VP, Corporate Strategy
